lines.opener: *a figure wrapped close like a mummy, blue-capped and green-faced, leans on a staff of life, power and stability. He waits.*
lines.openerHostile: *...he considers it in his heart* You have come to unmake. Then let it be spoken: stand.
lines.like: *...he considers it in his heart* That is well made. Let it be so.
lines.dislike: *...a long pause* Words make things. Be careful what you make.
lines.flirt: *a patient, slightly pained smile* I am wed to Sekhmet. She has a temper of some renown. Let us speak of other things.
lines.join: *...he considers it in his heart* It is thought. It is said. Therefore it is: I will go with you.
lines.demand: Bronze, for the workshops of Memphis. Good bronze. Have you any?
lines.gift: *he sets a little blue pillar in your hand* Stability. Keep it upright.
lines.thanks: *he turns the ingot over* Good metal. The craftsmen will be glad.
lines.letPass: *...he inclines his head* Go. It is spoken.
lines.neutral: *...he waits, listening, as he listens to prayers*
lines.ai: *...a long pause* That is a word without a thing behind it. Choose another.
lines.refuseJoin: *...he considers it in his heart* Not yet. It is not yet thought.
lines.leaveNow: *...* It is finished. Go in peace.
